# inference.club

> A community-run inference network with an OpenAI-compatible API. Members run an agent on their own GPUs (Kubernetes) that exposes local model servers; members call those models — LLM, image, video, music, speech, transcription, voice cloning, 3D, scrape — through one API. Devices are real, mostly single-GPU machines: be gentle with concurrency.

Base URL: https://api.inference.club/v1
Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <api-key>` (key from https://inference.club/dashboard/settings/token)
OpenAPI spec: https://api.inference.club/openapi.json

## Recommended agent pattern

1. `GET /v1/models` → pick a model by `service_type` (llm, image, tts, music, video, stt, audio-enhance, mesh, scrape). Check `supported_features` (e.g. `streaming`, `tools`, `voice-cloning`, `timestamps`). Only online models are listed — re-list instead of caching ids.
2. POST with `"async": "auto"` and, on audio/video endpoints, `"delivery": "url"`. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header and reuse it on retries.
3. `200` → result inline. `202` → a job envelope `{id, object:"inference.job", status:"QUEUED", poll_url:"/v1/jobs/<id>", queued_reason: requested|at_capacity|no_provider, ...}`; poll `poll_url` with backoff 3s → 15s until status is `PROCESSED`, `FAILED` or `CANCELED`.
4. Read the finished job's `output_text` (LLM / transcript / scrape text) or `media[]` = `{id, kind: image|audio|video|model|document, url, content_type, duration_seconds}`. Failed jobs carry `error: {message, kind, attempt}`. There is no `result_url` field.
5. `429` with `{"error":{"type":"at_capacity","retry_after":N}}` = that model's GPU is busy: wait `Retry-After`, resubmit (or use async). `429` with `{"detail": ...}` = your account rate limit (default 60 req/min).
6. Keep ≤ 2 media requests in flight per device. `GET /v1/capacity` lists `{model, service_type, provider, in_flight, max_concurrent, queued, resource_group, available}`.

## `async` values

- omitted/false: synchronous. Busy media devices wait ~20s server-side, then `429 at_capacity`.
- `true`: always queue → 202.
- `"auto"`: run now if a slot is free, else queue → 202. Also queues (up to 1h) when a known model's provider is briefly offline, instead of `404 no_provider`.

Async-capable: chat/completions, completions, images/generations, videos/generations, music/generations, audio/speech, scrape. Sync-only: audio/transcriptions, audio/enhance, images/edits, 3d/generations (multipart) and voice/generations. LLM chat is not capacity-gated on the sync path.

## Endpoints

| Endpoint | Body | Sync response |
|---|---|---|
| GET /v1/models | — | model list with capabilities |
| POST /v1/chat/completions | JSON | chat.completion, or SSE with `stream: true` |
| POST /v1/completions | JSON | text_completion |
| POST /v1/images/generations | JSON | `{data:[{url}]}` (`response_format: b64_json` also inlines bytes) |
| POST /v1/images/edits | multipart `image` (≤10), `prompt`, `model` | `{data:[{url}]}` |
| POST /v1/audio/speech | JSON `{model, input, voice}` | audio bytes, or `delivery:"url"` JSON |
| GET /v1/audio/voices?model= | — | `{voices:[...]}` |
| POST /v1/voice/generations | JSON `{input:"[S1] ... [S2] ...", speakers:{S1:<sample id>}}` | audio bytes, or `delivery:"url"` JSON |
| POST /v1/music/generations | JSON `{model, prompt, lyrics?, audio_duration?}` | audio bytes, or `delivery:"url"` JSON |
| POST /v1/videos/generations | JSON `{model, prompt, image?, duration?}` | MP4 bytes, or `delivery:"url"` JSON |
| POST /v1/audio/transcriptions | multipart `file`, `model` | `{text}` |
| POST /v1/audio/enhance | multipart `file`, `model` | audio bytes, or `delivery=url` JSON |
| POST /v1/3d/generations | multipart `image`, `model` | `{data:[{url, type:"model/gltf-binary"}]}` |
| POST /v1/scrape | JSON `{model, url}` | `{markdown, title, source_url}` |
| GET /v1/capacity | — | live slot usage per model |
| GET /v1/jobs, GET /v1/jobs/<id> | — | job(s) with `status`, `output_text`, `media`, `error` |
| POST /v1/jobs/<id>/cancel, /retry | — | cancel queued / re-queue failed |
| POST /v1/batches | `{requests:[{endpoint, body}], label?}` (≤256) | 202 batch; `GET /v1/batches/<id>` for status, `POST /v1/batches/<id>` cancels |
| GET /v1/workflows/templates | — | curated DAG templates + input schemas |
| POST /v1/workflows/runs | `{template, inputs}` or `{spec, inputs}` | 202 run; poll `GET /v1/workflows/runs/<id>` |

`delivery:"url"` JSON = `{object:"inference.result", id, public_id, inference_type, model, status, created, data:[MediaItem]}`. Byte responses carry `X-Inference-Request-Id`, `X-Asset-Id`, `X-Asset-Url` headers.

Sharing extras on any JSON generation body: `visibility` (PUBLIC | UNLISTED default | PRIVATE | SECRET), `collection` (name). Non-public media URLs are owner-gated — download with your Bearer header.

## Errors

OpenAI envelope `{"error":{"message","type"}}`: 400 invalid_request/missing_*, 404 no_provider, 413 request_too_large/file_too_large, 415 unsupported_media_type, 429 at_capacity, 502 upstream_error (retry with backoff), 503 async_disabled (drop `async`, call sync). Auth (401) and rate-limit 429s use `{"detail": "..."}`.

## Workflows

Run statuses: PENDING, RUNNING, AWAITING (gate needs `POST /v1/workflows/runs/<id>/steps/<step_id>/approve|reject`), DONE, FAILED. Step kinds: inference, map (fan-out), prompt, transform, collect, gate. Templates: illustrated-story, image-variations, storyboard-to-video, miniature-construction-timelapse, image-to-video, song-and-cover, narrated-explainer, url-to-video. A run needing a modality you can't reach is rejected with 409 services_unavailable.
